verses.text: The LORD called Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting. He said,
"Speak to the people of Israel and tell them: When any of you brings a gift to the LORD, bring an animal from your cattle or from your sheep and goats.
If the gift is a burnt offering from the cattle, it must be a male with nothing wrong with it. Bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, so that the LORD will accept it.
Put your hand on the head of the animal. Then it will be accepted for you, to make you right with God.
Kill the young bull in front of the LORD. Aaron's sons, the priests, will bring the blood and splash it all around the altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
Then skin the animal and cut it into pieces.
The sons of Aaron the priest will light a fire on the altar and lay wood neatly on the fire.
Then they will lay the pieces, the head, and the fat neatly on the wood burning on the altar.
But wash the inside parts and the legs with water. The priest will burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
If the burnt offering is from the flock, a sheep or a goat, it must be a male with nothing wrong with it.
Kill it on the north side of the altar in front of the LORD. Aaron's sons, the priests, will splash its blood all around the altar.
Cut it into pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest will lay them neatly on the wood burning on the altar.
But wash the inside parts and the legs with water. The priest will offer all of it and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
If the burnt offering to the LORD is a bird, bring a dove or a young pigeon.
The priest will bring it to the altar, twist off its head, and burn it on the altar. Its blood will be drained out on the side of the altar.
He will take away its throat pouch and its feathers, and throw them beside the altar on the east side, where the ashes are.

He will tear it open by its wings, but not pull it fully apart. Then the priest will burn it on the altar, on the wood on the fire. It is a burnt offering, a gift made by fire, with a smell that pleases the LORD.
